local LOADER = {}

LOADER[11] = bit32.bxor

function FN.mul32(self, r1_2, r2)
    local bit32_band = bit32.band
    r1_2, r2 = bit32_band(r1_2, 4294967295), bit32_band(r2, 4294967295)
    local M1, bit32_rshift = bit32_band(r1_2, 65535), bit32.rshift
    local d1, K1, m1 = bit32_rshift(r1_2, 16), bit32_band(r2, 65535), bit32_rshift(r2, 16)
    bit32_rshift = bit32_band(M1 * K1 + bit32.lshift(bit32_band(M1 * m1 + d1 * K1, 65535), 16), 4294967295)
    bit32_band = nil
    repeat
        K1 = bit32_rshift % 4294967296
        if K1 ~= K1 then
            bit32_band = 0
            break
        end
        bit32_band = K1 - K1 % 1
    until true
    return bit32_band
end

function FN.to_u32(self, r1)
    r1 %= 4294967296
    if r1 ~= r1 then
        return 0
    end
    return r1 - r1 % 1
end

function FN.loader_step_tk(self, r1)
    r1 %= 4294967296
    if r1 ~= r1 then
        return 0
    end
    return r1 - r1 % 1
end

function FN.loader_step_l(self, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7)

    end
end

function FN.run_invincibility(self, vm_arg2, vm_arg3)
    return function(closure_id, upvalues, slot_a)
        local cell = upvalues[1]
        return function(find_first_child_holder)
            if not find_first_child_holder then
                return false
            end
            local now = os.clock()
            local s2 = cell
            local p1 = s2[find_first_child_holder]
            if p1 and now - p1.at < 0.2 then
                return p1.v
            end
            p1 = find_first_child_holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") ~= nil or find_first_child_holder:FindFirstChild("InvincibilityParticles", true) ~= nil
            if not p1 then
                s2 = find_first_child_holder:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if s2 then
                    for key, value in ipairs(s2:GetChildren()) do
                        if value:IsA("Attachment") and value.Name == "Attachment" then
                            p1 = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            s2 = cell
            s2[find_first_child_holder] = {at = now, v = p1}
            return p1
        end
    end
end

            local get_setting_2, b3, w1, a1 = get_setting, os.clock() * (get_setting("XChamSpeed", 5) / 5), col2_holder.col

            end
            local m1, o3 = col2_holder.tint

                o3 = w1(l1 .. "Custom", false)
            else
                o3 = m1
            end
            if o3 then
                w1 = up4
                a1 = w1(l1 .. "Col", a1)
            end
            o3, l1 = col2_holder.alpha or 0, col2_holder.anim
            m1 = l1 == "rainbow"
            if m1 then
                a1 = Color3.fromHSV((b3 * 0.25 + g1 * 0.07) % 1, 0.75, 1)
            else

                if s2 then
                    w1 = col2_holder.cycle
                    local s3 = b3 * 0.35 % #w1
                    local floored, T2 = math.floor(s3), up5
                    a1 = T2(w1[floored + 1], w1[(floored + 1) % #w1 + 1], s3 - floored)
                else

                    if s4 then
                        local s5, p3 = col2_holder.col2 or a1, up5
                        a1 = p3(a1, s5, 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(b3 * 1.6))
                    else

                        if s6 then
                            local s7, p4 = 0.5 + 0.3 * math.sin(b3 * 3.1) + 0.2 * math.sin(b3 * 7.3 + g1), up5
                            a1 = p4(a1, col2_holder.col2 or a1, s7)

                                a1 = (Color3.fromHSV(hsv, p5, math.clamp(M1 * (0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(b3 * 2.4)), 0, 1)))

                    end

            end
            g1 = n5 == "Weapon"
            if g1 then
                m1, w1 = get_setting, math.clamp(get_setting("XChamWeaponAlpha", 0), 0, 90) / 100

function FN.loader_step_ok(self, r1, r2)
    local bit32_band = bit32.band
    r1, r2 = bit32_band(r1, 4294967295), bit32_band(r2, 4294967295)
    local p1, bit32_rshift = bit32_band(r1, 65535), bit32.rshift
    local N1, g1, l1 = bit32_rshift(r1, 16), bit32_band(r2, 65535), bit32_rshift(r2, 16)
    bit32_rshift = bit32_band(p1 * g1 + bit32.lshift(bit32_band(p1 * l1 + N1 * g1, 65535), 16), 4294967295)
    bit32_band = nil
    repeat
        l1 = bit32_rshift % 4294967296
        if l1 ~= l1 then
            bit32_band = 0
            break
        end
        bit32_band = l1 - l1 % 1
    until true
    return bit32_band
end
MODULE.Ok = FN.loader_step_ok
